test_title: PYST 26: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Tree, Trouser, Phone
solution:
These three items belong to entirely distinct categories and share no common elements or intersections:

A tree is a plant.

Trouser is an article of clothing.

A phone is an electronic communication device.

**They are mutually exclusive.**

The best Venn diagram to illustrate the relationship between Tree, Trouser, and Phone is one with "three separate, non-overlapping circles".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2735bf3e0bc711b9574a7cb589e37c185ed06c1afa271a7a777e08e10915a564.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
